connector.name: Schedulala
connector.registryDescription: Schedule and publish social posts to 12 platforms with first comments, analytics, and listening.
connector.summary: Hosted at schedulala.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.schedulala. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCHEDULALA_API_KEY
env.description: Schedulala API key (sk_live_ or sk_test_), minted at https://schedulala.com/dashboard?view=developer
